title: What the Harpy Eagle rules

is_this_you.pressure: Under strain your crest goes up before your voice does. The ones who know you read the feathers and step back.
is_this_you.love: You can sit near someone a whole season without showing a thing. Then one afternoon you have chosen, and you rarely take it back.
is_this_you.cost: You wait to be seen and refuse to ask. Whole seasons go by like that.

opener.text: The bird that carries your crossing was named for the harpies, the wind spirits of Greek myth who bore the dead away to Hades [s1]. It is a name for something that owns the air above the canopy. You were born to Leo, the one sign ruled by the Sun, in a year of the Tiger, whose element is yang Wood [s6] [s4]. We read that Wood as fuel laid under the Fire, so the quieter half of you is always keeping the brighter half alight.

howto: Three parts. Take them in order, from the top of the tree down.

tabs.label: Your height
tabs.intro: Fire that wants to be seen. Wood that waits to strike.

rows.text: Leo is fixed Fire, read as warm, proud and generous, with a real need to be recognised [s6] [s7]. The Tiger is brave, confident and a natural leader, and its shadow is the sudden, impetuous move [s4] [s5]. In you they meet as a great presence held in reserve, carried at full weight and spent rarely, so that when you finally move, everything below the canopy feels it.

A harpy eagle can reportedly hold one perch for up to 23 hours while it scans the trees for sloths and monkeys [s2]. Its talons are the largest of any living eagle, the longest close to 12.5 centimetres [s1] [s2]. All of that strength sits still for most of the day. Yours does too, and the stillness is where you keep it.

A harpy pair builds a nest about a metre and a half across and may use it over several years [s1] [s2]. They lay up to two eggs, raise one chick, and breed only every two or three years [s2]. In many South American cultures it is bad luck to cut down the kapok, a tree harpies favour for nesting [s1]. You build the same way, choosing one house or one venture and adding to it season after season, and you take any threat to it personally.
Lead something small and own it outright. Surgery and flying both reward the long watch and the single exact move.

tabs.label: Who rules beside you
tabs.intro: Three who can share the canopy, and one who will contest it.
tabs.love_lead: In love you protect and provide long before you talk. Harpy pairs hold a range of some 30 square kilometres and are believed to stay together for life [s2] [s1]. The old Chinese pairings name three who could rule beside you.

easy.why: The Albatross (Sagittarius, Horse year) shares your trine of Tiger, Horse and Dog, and Sagittarius burns with Fire like yours [s4].
The Giant Otter (Aries, Dog year) closes the trine, and its Aries Fire is loud enough to call you down from the branch [s4].
The Roseate Spoonbill (Libra, Pig year) is your secret friend, since the Pig is the Tiger's hidden ally [s4].

hard.why: The hard one is the Raven: the Monkey clashes with the Tiger, and Aquarius sits opposite Leo [s4] [s6].

story.text: Chinese painters set the eagle, 鹰 (yīng), beside the bear, 熊 (xióng), so the pair would read as 英雄 (yīngxióng), hero [s8] [s9]. Painted alone in a pine, the eagle meant strength carried into old age [s8].

closing: Choose your tree. Then hold it, and let them see you hold it.
